description: Stratified 10-scene canonical H3 frame bank for t2va (fl2va) and ref2va short-contrast control vector compilation. Each frame is a complete, neutral 3-section (t2va) or 6-section (ref2va) H3 prompt with 6 structural clause slots (opening_framing, subject_behavior, interpersonal_dynamics, camera_motion, speech_delivery, soundscape) and per-frame pronoun bindings.

slot_defaults.opening_framing: filmed with balanced natural contrast and true-to-life color
slot_defaults.subject_behavior: maintains a composed, natural posture and steady hand coordination
slot_defaults.interpersonal_dynamics: The surrounding air and room fixtures remain calm and undisturbed
slot_defaults.speech_delivery: says in a clear, conversational tone
slot_defaults.soundscape: Balanced room acoustics carry natural close perspective.

The camera {camera_motion}. (S1) {speech_delivery}, <d>[English] The mainspring tension is finally balanced.</d>
